comments.author: Muhammad
comments.body:
Interesting, SS Savannah was the first steamship to cross the Atlantic Ocean... Hybrid ship.

Adventurer ship for sure.

comments.author: Rufas
comments.body: If its cargo is anything like Clermont's, not a chance.

comments.author: Muhammad
comments.body: IRL Clermont used to sail around 4 knots, Savannah sailed from Atlantic around 10 knots... and she was not made for cargo, she was a full-rigged ship with additional paddle wheel propulsion - built to cross Atlantic.

comments.author: Rufas
comments.body: I never said that it would be made for cargo, I just said 'if' it is, and since most astro variants of FS ships follow the same general characteristics of the original, I think it's more than likely that it will. I have no issue with being proven wrong however, in fact it would be nice to see a fast variant.

comments.author: pampo
comments.body: This ship is just like Clermont but much faster acceleration and top speed. As tested on other servers you can get from London to Lisbon within 4m with coal loaded but u know they are expensive.. great for short distance
